description: This file implements a safe regex compiler and validator, including functions for tokenizing regex patterns, analyzing nested repetitions, caching compiled regexes, and providing safe regex compilation results with rejection reasons.

methods.name: createParseFrame
methods.description: Creates a new parse frame object used for regex pattern analysis.

methods.name: addLength
methods.description: Adds two length values, returning infinity if either is not finite.

methods.name: multiplyLength
methods.description: Multiplies a length by a factor, handling infinity appropriately.

methods.name: recordAlternative
methods.description: Records the minimum and maximum lengths of an alternative branch in regex pattern analysis.

methods.name: readQuantifier
methods.description: Parses a quantifier from a regex pattern string at a given index.

methods.name: tokenizePattern
methods.description: Converts a regex pattern string into a list of tokens for analysis.

methods.name: analyzeTokensForNestedRepetition
methods.description: Analyzes tokenized regex pattern to detect nested repetitions.

methods.name: testRegexFromStart
methods.description: Tests if a regex matches from the start of a string.

methods.name: testRegexWithBoundedInput
methods.description: Tests regex matching with input length bounded by a window size.

methods.name: hasNestedRepetition
methods.description: Checks if a regex pattern contains nested repetitions, indicating potential unsafe patterns.

methods.name: compileSafeRegexDetailed
methods.description: Compiles a regex pattern into a safe regex object, returning reasons for rejection if unsafe or invalid.

methods.name: compileSafeRegex
methods.description: Simplified interface to compile a regex pattern into a RegExp object if safe.
